title: LLM Whisperer: An Inconspicuous Attack to Bias LLM Responses
reasoning: The paper focuses on a security attack aimed at manipulating LLM outputs through subtle prompt alterations. While it discusses the ethical implications of 'deceptive design' and 'user autonomy,' its core experiments involve commercial brand recommendations and neutral societal topics rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical frameworks.
